missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Вещество' is the neuter nominative subject. 'Это' and 'опасно' show neuter agreement, stating a property of the substance.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Вещество' is the accusative direct object of 'изучает'; neuter inanimate accusative equals nominative. 'Новое' agrees in the neuter.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Вещества' is genitive after 'нет'. 'Этого' agrees in the neuter genitive, and 'в пробирке' is the prepositional place.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Веществом' is instrumental after 'с', expressing what they work with. 'Этим' agrees in the neuter instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'Веществе' is prepositional after 'в', stating where the iron is. 'Много железа' uses the genitive after a quantity word.
Strategic focus: Dative with preposition. 'Веществу' is dative after 'к', marking what the water is added to. 'Немного воды' uses the genitive of quantity.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Вещества' is the nominative plural subject of 'существуют'. 'Разные' agrees, and 'в природе' is the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Вещества' is the accusative plural object of 'исследует'; neuter inanimate plural accusative equals nominative. 'Опасные' agrees in the plural.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Веществ' is genitive plural, expressing possession of properties. The zero ending is typical for neuter nouns in the genitive plural.
Strategic focus: Genitive of material. 'Вещества' is genitive after 'из', naming the material used. 'Лекарства' is the accusative plural object of 'делают'.
